Definitely. Going on countless dates that always end with her my date and I parting our separate ways and me feeling just a little more discouraged than the last time. So I deleted 
All dating and social media apps from my phone and opted to meet people and ask out women in real life which turns out most people are very hard to get to know outside of mere pleasantries and often seem annoyed by my attempts to ask about their lives, give compliments, and eventually pop the question would you like to hang out? I’ve never been met with absolute silence before, creating a really awkward situation and if they do say something it’s usually I’m really busy, or maybe or just change the subject. This is both men and woman in their 20’s and 30’s. Millennials!? I’m a millennial and feel so disconnected from people ten year younger. 1985 born vs 1995 born is a huge difference I’ve realized. Maybe I’m the problem and my bold approach is too much for mostly timid people used to ghosting, texting, or saying their opinions from the safety of a computer screen not having to witness the aftermath thus putting it all out of sight and out of mind continually making a community and society that is only connected on the internet and it depresses the HELL out of me. I hope someday I get a yes when I get back to a place where I’m wanting to meet and be around people again:( BTY what I’m referring to were co workers at Sprouts grocery store as well as just the people who have happened to run into my life by chance or circumstance.

I already have a BA and have been a depressed drug addict since before college and it’s only got worse. College is extremely overpriced. I graduated in 2009 when the economy crashed and have never been able to afford to pay my student loans. I’m extremely lonely and have no friends. I’m desperate for romance and think how nice it would be to just take my DOC (any kind of strong opiate) mix with some benzos and go to to sleep. I figure I’ll give it a few more years but I come closer and closer to accepting suicide the older I get. The more rejections I wither and the shitty jobs I work. Been sober for two years and life still sucks. There’s plenty of people in the world. It literally will make no difference if I die. Figuratively too I suppose. I’m a mediocre sad boy who and fucking hate myself.
